description: This file defines a mock implementation of the IClusterMembershipService interface used for unit testing within the Orleans runtime. It manages cluster member statuses, provides snapshots of the current cluster state, and allows status updates for silos.

classes.name: MockClusterMembershipService
classes.description: A mock implementation of IClusterMembershipService for unit testing, managing cluster member statuses and their snapshots.

methods.name: MockClusterMembershipService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mock service with optional initial silo statuses.

methods.name: UpdateSiloStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and name of a specific silo and publishes a new snapshot.

methods.name: ToSnapshot
methods.description: Converts the current statuses dictionary into a ClusterMembershipSnapshot with a given version.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: A no-op method to satisfy interface; intended to refresh cluster info, but currently does nothing.

methods.name: TryKill
methods.description: Method stub to simulate killing a silo; not implemented in this mock.
